name: Murkrow
description: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user attacks by crying out as if it's ranting about something. This also lowers the target's offensive stats.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the target the instant the target lowers its guard. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts, raising the user's offensive stats.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This attack never misses.
